topics.title: Select inside a function
topics.desc: Place cursor inside a function. `vi{` selects the body, `va{` includes the braces. Works with any {} block.
topics.keys: vi{  or  va{  or  vib / vab (for bracket text-objects)

topics.title: Select text between quotes
topics.desc: `vi"` selects inside double quotes. `ci"` changes inside double quotes. Works with `'` ` ` too.
topics.keys: vi"  or  va"  or  ci"  or  ca"

topics.title: Select between parentheses
topics.desc: `vi)` or `vi(` selects inside parentheses. `va)` includes the parens. `ci)` to change inside.
topics.keys: vi(  or  va(  or  ci(  or  ca(

topics.title: Select a word
topics.desc: `viw` selects the current word. `vaw` includes trailing whitespace. `ciw` replaces the word.
topics.keys: viw  or  vaw  or  ciw  or  daw (delete a word)

topics.title: Select current line
topics.desc: `V` selects the current line (visual line mode). `Vjj` extends selection down.

topics.title: Select a paragraph
topics.desc: `vip` selects the current paragraph (text between blank lines). `vap` includes the trailing blank line.
topics.keys: vip  or  vap  or  dip (delete paragraph)

topics.title: Select HTML/XML tag content
topics.desc: `vit` selects inside a tag pair. `vat` includes the tags. Works for any HTML/XML.
topics.keys: vit  or  vat  or  cit (change inside tag)

topics.title: Select all text in buffer
topics.desc: `ggVG` selects everything. Or use `<C-a>` with current config.

topics.title: Copy (yank) text
topics.desc: `yy` yanks current line. `yiw` yanks inner word. `y$` yanks to end of line. `"+y` yanks to system clipboard.
topics.keys: yy  or  yiw  or  y$  or  "+y

topics.title: Cut (delete) text
topics.desc: `dd` deletes current line. `diw` deletes inner word. `d$` deletes to end of line. `d}` deletes to end of paragraph.
topics.keys: dd  or  diw  or  d$  or  d}  or  di{ (delete inside {})

topics.title: Paste text
topics.desc: `p` pastes after cursor. `P` pastes before cursor. `"+p` pastes from system clipboard.

topics.title: Undo and Redo
topics.desc: `u` to undo last change. `<C-r>` to redo. `.` repeats last change.

topics.title: Save file
topics.desc: `:w` saves the file. `<C-s>` also saves. `:wq` saves and quits.

topics.title: Quit / close buffer
topics.desc: `:q` quits window. `:q!` force quit. `<leader>q` quick quit. `<leader>bc` smart close buffer.

topics.title: Toggle comment
topics.desc: `<leader>cc` toggles line comment. `<leader>cb` toggles block comment. Works in visual mode too.

topics.title: Indent / dedent
topics.desc: `>>` indents line. `<<` dedents. In visual mode: `<` or `>` indents selection, `gv` reselects.

topics.title: Move lines up/down (visual mode)
topics.desc: In visual mode: `K` moves selected lines up, `J` moves down.

topics.title: Find and replace
topics.desc: `:%s/old/new/g` replaces all. `:%s/old/new/gc` with confirmation. `<leader>sr` replaces word under cursor.

topics.title: Search for word
topics.desc: `*` searches word under cursor (forward). `#` searches backward. `n`/`N` to go next/prev.
topics.keys: *  or  #  or  n  or  N  or  /pattern

topics.title: Clear search highlights
topics.desc: `<leader>hn` clears search highlighting.

topics.title: Switch between buffers
topics.desc: `<leader>bn` next buffer. `<leader>bP` previous. `<Tab>` next, `<S-Tab>` previous. `<leader>bb` toggle last.

topics.title: Close buffer smartly
topics.desc: `<leader>bc` closes current buffer and auto-switches to neighbor. `<C-w>` same action. `<leader>bC` close others.

topics.title: Find buffer
topics.desc: `<leader>bf` opens Telescope buffer picker. Type to filter and select.

topics.title: Find file
topics.desc: `<leader>ff` opens Telescope file search. Type filename or path fragments.

topics.title: Open recent files
topics.desc: `<leader>fo` or `<leader>r` on dashboard shows recently opened files.

topics.title: Toggle file explorer
topics.desc: `<leader>e` toggles Neo-tree file explorer.

topics.title: Navigate between windows
topics.desc: `<C-h>` left, `<C-j>` down, `<C-k>` up, `<C-l>` right. Works in normal and visual modes.

topics.title: Resize windows
topics.desc: `<leader>w` enters resize mode, then use `j`/`k`/`h`/`l`. `<Esc>` to exit.

topics.title: Create window splits
topics.desc: `<leader>ts` horizontal split. `<leader>tv` vertical split.

topics.title: Work with tabs
topics.desc: `<leader>tn` new tab. `<leader>tc` close tab. `<leader>tf` next, `<leader>tp` previous. `<leader>t1-9` to go to tab N.

topics.title: Git commit
topics.desc: `<leader>gg` opens Neogit. `S` stages all, `c` then `c` to commit. Write message, `:wq`.

topics.title: Quick commit (stage all + commit)
topics.desc: `<leader>gc` opens commit popup. Toggle `-a` with `a` to stage all, then `c`.

topics.title: Git push
topics.desc: `<leader>gp` pushes commits. Or inside Neogit: press `P`.

topics.title: Git pull
topics.desc: `<leader>gl` pulls from remote. Or inside Neogit: press `p`.

topics.title: Git status / diff
topics.desc: `<leader>gg` opens Neogit. Shows unstaged/staged changes. `<leader>gs` opens Fugitive status.

topics.title: Git blame line
topics.desc: `<leader>gm` shows who last modified the current line.

topics.title: Revert a commit
topics.desc: In Neogit: move cursor to the commit, press `v` to create a revert commit (safe).

topics.title: Go to definition
topics.desc: `gd` jumps to symbol definition. `<C-o>` jumps back.

topics.title: Rename symbol
topics.desc: `<leader>lr` renames the symbol under cursor across all files.

topics.title: Code actions / quick fix
topics.desc: `<leader>la` shows available code actions (auto-fix, refactor, etc.).

topics.title: Format code
topics.desc: `<leader>lf` formats the current buffer using LSP formatter.

topics.title: Hover / show docs
topics.desc: `K` shows documentation, type info, and hover details for symbol under cursor.

topics.title: Find all references
topics.desc: `<leader>lF` or `<leader>fr` shows all places where symbol is used.

topics.title: Navigate diagnostics
topics.desc: `[d` previous diagnostic, `]d` next diagnostic. `<leader>dn` and `<leader>dp` for Trouble panel.

topics.title: Diagnostics panel
topics.desc: `<leader>dd` toggles diagnostics panel below the file tree.

topics.title: Autocomplete / snippets
topics.desc: `<Tab>` accepts completion. `<C-j>/<C-k>` to navigate suggestions. Type and blink.cmp completes.

topics.title: Toggle terminal
topics.desc: `<leader>`` opens/closes the built-in terminal.

topics.title: Switch theme
topics.desc: `<leader>tt` toggles between light/dark theme. `<leader>th` picks a theme.

topics.title: Switch project
topics.desc: `<leader>fp` opens Telescope project picker to switch between recent projects.

topics.title: Discover available keymaps
topics.desc: `<leader>?` shows all buffer-local keymaps. Press `<leader>` and wait for which-key popup.

topics.title: Edit / reload Neovim config
topics.desc: `<leader>re` opens init.lua. `<leader>rr` reloads config. `<leader>lR` restarts LSP clients.

topics.title: Change inner / around text object
topics.desc: `ci` + object changes inside. `ca` + object changes around (includes delimiters). E.g., `ci"` changes inside quotes.
topics.keys: ci{object}  or  ca{object}   e.g. ci"  ci(  ci[  ci<  cit

topics.title: Delete inner / around text object
topics.desc: `di` + object deletes inside. `da` + object deletes around. E.g., `di{` deletes inside braces.
topics.keys: di{object}  or  da{object}   e.g. di{  di"  di(  dat

topics.title: Visual block mode
topics.desc: `<C-v>` enters visual block mode. Select columns, then `I` to insert before, `A` to append after.

topics.title: Record and replay macro
topics.desc: `qa` starts recording into register `a`. Do actions, `q` stops. `@a` replays. `@@` repeats last.

topics.title: Jump to any visible word
topics.desc: `f{char}` jumps to next `char` on line. `t{char}` jumps before. `;` repeats. `,` reverses.

topics.title: Go to line
topics.desc: `{line}G` jumps to specific line. `gg` to top. `G` to bottom. `:42` goes to line 42.

topics.title: Set and jump to marks
topics.desc: `ma` sets mark `a`. `'a` jumps to line of mark `a`. `` `a `` jumps to exact position. `:marks` lists all.

topics.title: Grep across files
topics.desc: `<leader>fg` opens Telescope live_grep. Type pattern, results update live.

topics.title: Search symbols in file
topics.desc: `<leader>fs` opens Treesitter symbols picker (functions, classes, etc.).
